source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 337 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 337 was established by Ordinance No. 20748, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 26, 1990. Ordinance No. 20748 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 337 is established on property generally fronting on the southeast line of Inwood Road, northeast of the northeast line of Redfield Street. The size of PD 337 is approximately 12.8487 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, and sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, and sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 337A). (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.105. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 337B). All landscaping must be installed as required by the Dallas Development Code. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.106. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are an auto auction and all uses permitted in an IR Industrial Research District. The auto auction use must be located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Days And Hours Of Operation Of Auction
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.107. DAYS AND HOURS OF OPERATION OF AUCTION.

The auto auction use may operate only between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., and may operate a maximum of 24 days in a calendar year. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Mandatory Reassessment
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.108. MANDATORY REASSESSMENT.

Three years after September 26, 1990, the commission must hold a public hearing to reassess this district. Notice of this public hearing must be given to those property owners entitled to notice of a public hearing for a zoning amendment on the Property pursuant to the Dallas Development Code. The commission may exercise its power pursuant to the Dallas Development Code to call a public hearing to determine proper zoning if the commission determines that the calling of a hearing is warranted by the findings at the reassessment hearing. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.109. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking and loading for each use must be provided in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.110. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

All development standards must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations for an IR Industrial Research District as provided in Section 51A-4.123(c)(4). (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.111. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.112. FENCES.

Fences must be provided in accordance with the development plan and fence elevation drawing (Exhibit 337C). (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-337.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 337 is located on Zoning Map Nos. H-6 and I-6. (Ord. Nos. 20748; 25850)
